info.title: RuehrAI API
info.description:
Dev-Team slice (v0). The backend issues its own JWTs and reads a local
Postgres database via `DATABASE_URL`. Clients call this API; they do not
talk to the database.

Base URL is environment-driven. Local default is `http://localhost:3000`
(`PORT`, default 3000). Deployed clients should take the base URL from
their own configuration and use this document as the contract.

Local migrations seed a development user `dev@ruehrai.local` /
`dev-password`. That account is a fixture for local runs, not a production
credential. `POST /auth/register` creates further users in `app.users`.
`POST /auth/logout` revokes that access token until it expires.

Customer inputs (target-region list, store addresses, monthly revenue) are
stored in schema `app` and are visible only to the user id in the token.
The signed-in user has a list of target regions. That list is the set used
for the location search, not a single overwrite slot. `0.6.1` adds
`gemeinde` to `CatalogLevel` for a municipality (grain `ags`).
`0.7.0` adds `POST /address-pair`: two addresses, looked up by postal code
only, returning Gemeinde / Kreis / Land topics from Brain.
`0.8.0` adds `AnalysisPattern.yearlySeries`: stored Brain values for the
last three calendar years (or last 36 months) on the user's Zielregionen.
`coverage` is `single` when only one period is present — that is not a
trend. Missing periods are `absent` (liegt nicht vor).
`0.9.0` maps the remaining Brain multi-year themes (`destatis_wohnungen`,
`destatis_kfz_bestand`, `destatis_bevoelkerung_alter`, `kba_elektro_pkw`,
`ba_sgb2`, `kba_neuzulassungen`, `kba_bestand`, `unfallatlas_gebiet`) onto
`yearlySeries`, prefers the most local Unfallatlas Gebiet key, uses
Berlin Regionalstatistik Bezirk AGS8 (`11007007`) when present, strips
`ref_period` tags after `|`, never filters on embedding, always
recomputes the field on `GET /analysis/pattern` and new runs, and
anchors a yearly window to the latest Brain year when that year is still
within two years of `asOf`. Placeholder KBA Elektro zeros and geo
identifiers (`ba_schluessel`, `geo_ags`) are never series values. Count
metrics (dwellings, population, age-band and other person counts, SGB2
BG/PERS) are whole numbers; rates, shares, and percentages stay
fractional. An Ortsteil
or Stadtteil Zielregion still returns the `yearlySeries` array; missing
local rows fall back to Gemeinde, Kreis, or Land keys and are labeled
as such. Grain `ags5` / a 5-digit AGS (Köln `05315`) is `kreis` for
that lookup, never `gemeinde`.
`0.10.0` lets `GET /analysis/pattern` take optional `geoKey` (the same
catalog key as `TargetRegion.geoKey`). When set, the newest completed run
whose snapshot includes that place is returned; `yearlySeries` is limited
to that Zielregion; `region` names the matched snapshot place for the
Stand line. No matching run is `404` with a German message, never another
region's pattern. Without `geoKey` the newest completed run is unchanged.
Create stays `POST /analysis/runs` (full list snapshot). Marking a
Zielregion is UI-only.
`0.11.0` remodels Musteranalyse criteria and `POST /recommendations`
(Stufe 1). Candidates are Teilflächen inside the Zielregion (Ortsteil,
Bezirk, PLZ5; Gemeinden when the region is a Kreis), never the
Zielregion geoKey itself. Pattern criteria come from Bestandstandort
surroundings (Ortsteil/PLZ plus Gemeinde-/Kreis-Dreijahresreihen), not
from clipping Brain facts to the Zielregion. Ranking uses the
three-year trend where a series exists; Stichtag values are labeled
as Stichtag and are not month-to-month direction. Missing cells stay
absent (`liegt nicht vor`), never `0`. Address grain is empty in Brain;
Stage 1 returns areas, not street addresses. `GET /analysis/pattern`
`yearlySeries` for the marked Zielregion is unchanged (Verlauf).
`0.12.0` returns only the **finest** hits per Zielregion (Adresse →
100-m-Raster → Ortsteil → PLZ5 → Bezirk → Gemeinde). Parent/ancestor
areas are omitted when a finer child exists. Membership prefers
`geo.geo_ref_zielregion_teil`. Criteria observed only on a coarser
admin level are `scope: inherited` and do not differentiate siblings.
`Recommendation.kind` is the Ebene. Admin map coordinates use
`geom_4326` / `geom_display` (EPSG:4326); `geo.geo_ref_admin.geom`
is EPSG:3035.
`0.12.1` scores kleinräumige Brain yearly series at the hit's own
Ebene. `hamburg_stadtteil_regionalstatistik` feeds Ortsteil / Stadtteil
(`ortsteil:{id}`, fallback `hamburg_stadtteil:{id}`).
`muenchen_indikatorenatlas` feeds Stadtbezirk (`bezirk:{id}`) and the
München Stadt AGS. `berlin_lor_ewr_bevoelkerung` feeds LOR
(`lor:{RAUMID}`). Local series beat inherited parent series.
Missing years stay `absent` (no zero-fill). Embedding is not required.
`0.13.0` corrects the finest→coarse order to Adresse → 100-m-Raster →
LOR Planungsraum / Köln-Quartier → Ortsteil → PLZ5 → Bezirk → Gemeinde.
`AreaKind` / `SeriesLevel` add `quartier` and keep `address` and `lor`.
Berlin 2021 PLR keys are `lor:plr:*` (`lor_version=2021`, ~542,
outlines in `geo.geo_ref_lor`); 2006 LOR (`lor:{RAUMID}`, 2001–2020)
is a separate series and is never concatenated with PLR. Prefer PLR
for Stage-1 when present. Köln Quartiere use `koeln:sq:*` (~570,
2012–2025) and beat quartier→bezirk `parent_fallback` rows.
Further kleinräumige themes: `koeln_statistischer_datenkatalog`
(Ortsteil 86 / Bezirk 9 / Quartier), `leipzig_lis_ortsteil`
(Ortsteil 29), `duesseldorf_bevoelkerung_stadtteile` (OT 49 / BZ 10),
`essen_bevoelkerung_stadtteile` (OT 50), `frankfurt_demographie_stadtteile`
(OT 40, 2010–2024). Official addresses are read from
`geo.geo_ref_address` (Berlin, Hamburg, NRW) when rows exist; an
empty or missing table is skipped and finest-only continues. Addresses
are never invented. Membership prefers `geo.geo_ref_zielregion_teil`.
`0.14.0` builds the store-surroundings Muster spiegelbildlich on every
Ebene (Adresse → 100-m-Raster → LOR/Quartier → Ortsteil → PLZ5 →
Bezirk → Gemeinde; Kreis as `role: frame` only). Zielregion candidates
are compared to the store pattern of the **same** Ebene. Inherited
criteria still do not differentiate siblings; the score uses local
trends of that Ebene only. `RecommendationSet.patternByLevel` exposes
that Musterprofil (geoKeys, yearlySeries, criteria with
`scope: local|inherited`) on POST 201 and GET 200. Additive; older
stored sets may omit the field. `PatternCriterion.scope` is optional.
`0.15.0` compares **datasets**, not Ebenen. Each store-surrounding
series is baselined (`per_1000_inhabitants`, `per_km2`, or
`per_household`) on its own Fläche; the three-year trend uses
`normalizedValue`, never raw counts. Missing Bezugsgröße is `absent`
(liegt nicht vor), never `0`. Pattern and score run per `metricId` at
the finest Fläche where that dataset exists (Berlin Bezirk vs Köln PLZ
still match relatively). Several datasets yield the smallest common
hit (intersection of those Flächen). `patternByDataset` is the
compare profile; `patternByLevel` stays a geography inventory.
Hierarchy Adresse→…→Gemeinde still chooses Flächen. Additive.
`0.16.0` takes Bezugsgrößen from Brain `geo.area_baseline` (PK
`geo_key`, `grain`, `ref_year`) and `geo.baseline_metric_catalog`
(`source_theme` → `einwohner` / `flaeche_km2` / `haushalte`).
`baselineMethod` on `SeriesPoint`, `PatternCriterion`,
`PatternDatasetProfile`, and `RecommendationEvidence` is the method
of the divisor (`official`, `estimate_lor_sum`, `estimate_address`,
`missing`, `geom`, `fixed_grid`). `einwohner_method` is never a
silent NULL; `missing` omits `normalizedValue` and never divides by
1. Catalog-first per theme. Zensus-Gitter-EW is not in v1 (grid100
often `estimate_address` or absent). Additive.

Analysis (0.3.0) snapshots that input, reads kleinräumige Brain facts for
the target region, and persists a pattern (criteria and direction).
Recommendations (0.12.0) rank the finest Teilflächen inside that
region against the store-surroundings pattern over three calendar
years, and attach a German rationale per area.

Map (0.5.0) keeps store pins and the target-region overlay on this API.
Store `lon`/`lat` are WGS84. Clients are not required to send them.
KAN-56 Option A: when a write omits both, the API looks up Data-Scout
`geo_ref_address` (street and house number plus PLZ). The PLZ5 centroid
(`geo_ref_plz`, then `app.search_places` or a Point in `app.map_features`)
is used only when that address misses. If the client sends both `lon` and
`lat`, that pair is stored as sent. No public geocoder is called.
Each saved target region has `bounds` (west, south, east, north) for map
fitBounds together with store pins, and `geometry` (GeoJSON Polygon or
MultiPolygon, EPSG:4326, longitude then latitude) for a semi-transparent
fill and outline. Labels stay client-side. Clients call only this API.

servers.description: Local development. The host and port follow the backend `PORT` env (default 3000).

get.description: Process is up. This check does not query Postgres.

post.summary: Exchange email and password for a JWT
post.description:
Returns a bearer token. Local databases seeded by `db/migrations`
include `dev@ruehrai.local` / `dev-password`.

503.description:
The database connection failed after a short retry. The credentials
were not rejected.

post.summary: Create a user and return a JWT
post.description:
Password hashing is done in Postgres (`pgcrypto` bcrypt) and the row is
stored in `app.users`. Minimum password length is 8. The response matches
`POST /auth/login`.

503.description:
The database connection failed after a short retry. The body was
not rejected and the email was not reported as a duplicate.

200.description: User row for the token subject.

post.description:
Requires `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Stores the token id
(`jti`) in `app.revoked_tokens` until the token's own expiry. A later
request with the same token is `401`. Clients should also drop the
token locally. This is the Slice-1 session end: JWTs stay stateless
apart from this denylist. There is no refresh token.

204.description: Token revoked. The body is empty.

400.description: The token has no revocable id.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's target regions
get.description:
The saved set used for the location search. Newest add first.
An empty list is `200` with `items: []`, not `404`.

Each item keeps the fields clients already show for a catalog hit:
place name (`label`), `level`, and `parentLabel`. `geoKey` stays in
the JSON so a later add or remove can name the place. Nothing in this
API requires a client to display that key.

`level` is the catalog token: `plz`; `bezirk` only for Berlin
`11000001`–`11000012`; `stadtbezirk` for every other Bezirk;
`stadtteil` or `ortsteil` from the catalog kind; `gemeinde` for a
municipality (grain `ags`, such as München `09162000`). Never
`gemeinde` for a sub-area. `parentLabel` is the parent municipality
name, not a second name for the area. Empty when the catalog has no
parent (München has none).

post.summary: Add a catalog place to the target-region list
post.description:
Appends one place. Existing items stay. The new item is first on the
next `GET`. This is not an overwrite of the whole list. There is no
`PUT /target-region` that replaces the only row.

Name the place with `geoKey`, `ags`, or `plz` from `GET /search`.
Exact `geoKey` / `ags` / `plz` lookup still reloads a stored place
on search; this write uses that same id. A historical Berlin Bezirk
alias `11` + nnn + nnn is stored as official `1100000N`.

A successful add always persists non-null `geometry` and `bounds`
copied from the catalog MultiPolygon (Brain `geo`, then a non-stub
`app.map_features` row, then Data-Scout). A GeoJSON Polygon or
MultiPolygon on the request is stored instead. `bounds` without a
polygon are ignored and do not become a rectangle. Never persist
null geometry. If the catalog has no outline, the add is `400` and
the list is unchanged. A municipality that simply has no sub-area
is not an error; it can be added when it has an outline.

The same catalog key appears at most once. A second add of that key
returns the stored item and does not insert another row.

`label`, `level`, and `parentLabel` are stored from the catalog hit
when present. A municipality is returned as `level` `gemeinde`.

200.description: Place was already in the list.

delete.description: Idempotent. Responds `204` even when the list was empty.

204.description: List cleared. The body is empty.

delete.summary: Remove one place from the target-region list
delete.description:
Deletes the item whose stored catalog key matches `geoKey` after the
same Berlin-alias rewrite as add. Idempotent: `204` when the key is
not in the list. Other items stay.

204.description: Place removed, or it was not in the list. The body is empty.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's store addresses
get.description:
A read persists `lon`/`lat` when the stored pair is null, or when an
address match in Data-Scout replaces a pin that still sits on a PLZ
centroid. An explicit pair is returned unchanged. Resolution order is
the same as create.

200.description: Stores owned by the token's user, oldest first.

post.description:
German address (`postalCode` is PLZ5, `countryCode` is `DE`).
`street` includes the house number. `lon` and `lat` are optional WGS84
(EPSG:4326) for the map pin. Clients are not required to send them.
Send both or neither. KAN-56 Option A, when both are omitted:

1. Data-Scout `geo_ref_address` (`strasse` + `hnr` parsed from `street`,
   plus `plz`). Berlin OSM coverage. This is the house-number pin.
2. Data-Scout `geo_ref_plz` centroid, only when step 1 misses.
3. PLZ centroid from `app.search_places`, then a Point in
   `app.map_features` with that PLZ, only when steps 1 and 2 miss.

Steps 1 and 2 run only when `DATASCOUT_DATABASE_URL` is set and the
read succeeds. Otherwise the API uses step 3. Coordinates stay null
only when none of the steps hit. No public geocoder is called.
Update uses the same order. A pair sent by the client is stored
unchanged; it is an optional override, not the primary source.
A read persists a filled null pair, and replaces a stored PLZ centroid
when step 1 hits.

get.description: 404 when the id is missing or belongs to another user.

200.description: Store owned by the token's user.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

put.description:
Same coordinate rule as create. Omit `lon` and `lat` together to
resolve Data-Scout `geo_ref_address`, then `geo_ref_plz`, then the
`app.search_places` / `app.map_features` PLZ stub. Send both to keep
an explicit WGS84 pin.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

delete.description: Also deletes monthly revenue for that store.

204.description: Store deleted. The body is empty.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

get.description:
Points the customer has saved, ordered by year then month. A point with
`revenueEur: null` was explicitly marked missing. A month with no point
was not entered. At most 36 points are stored per store.

200.description: Saved months. Empty `points` when none have been entered.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

put.description:
Inserts or replaces each `(year, month)` in the body. Other saved months
stay. `revenueEur: null` marks that month as missing. The store can hold
at most 36 months; a request that would exceed that returns `400` and
changes nothing.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

delete.description:
`204` when the store exists, including when that month was not stored.
`404` when the store is missing or belongs to another user.

204.description: Month removed, or it was not stored. The body is empty.

404.description: No store with this id for the token's user.

get.summary: Search places by name, grain, or geo key
get.description:
Reads Brain `geo` (PLZ, Stadtbezirk, Stadtteil, Ortsteil) together with
`features.v_location_search` when that view contains at least one row.
Free-text `q` matches the place name and, for catalog rows, `parentLabel`.
It does not match internal catalog keys (`id`, `geo_key`, `geo_ags`) such
as `plz5:12247`, `ortsteil:osm:…`, `stadtteil:osm:…`,
`stadtbezirk:osm:…`, or `ags:…`. Typing one of those keys as `q` returns
no hit. `lon` and `lat` are JSON null when the row has no coordinates.
A row without a name is omitted; `label` is never empty.

`q` is a substring of visible text. `type` limits `q` to grain `ags`,
`plz5`/`plz8`, or `address`. Without `type`, `q` matches name and title
(and catalog `parentLabel`). `type` has no effect when `q` is omitted.
PLZ hits (`level=plz`, or grain `plz5`/`plz8`) appear only when the
whole `q` is digits, for example `12247` or `80331`. A name query such
as München, Hamburg, or Leipzig never returns PLZ rows. Ortsteil,
Stadtteil, Stadtbezirk, and Bezirk still match a name query.

`ags` and `plz` are exact geo_key matches on that grain. `geoKey` is an
exact geo_key or catalog `id` match on any grain (reload of a stored
place). `grain` is exact. `address` is a substring of name and title.
Filters combine with AND.
At most 50 hits, ordered by exact id/label match, then label.

If the view is missing or has no rows (local docker-compose), the same
filters run against the seeded `app.search_places` catalog and are
merged with `geo` hits. Coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326) when present.
Rows with null or empty `geom` never appear. Berlin districts already
in the seed or the view are not listed twice.

A hit is a place id (`id`, `geoKey`, `grain`), not a polygon. Catalog
hits also send `level` and `parentLabel` (and `geoAgs` when `geo_ags`
is set). A municipality hit sends `level` `gemeinde` instead of
omitting it. The Zielregion picker sends that id to `POST /target-region`
without `geometry`. The write looks up a MultiPolygon in Brain `geo`,
then a non-stub `app.map_features` row, then Data-Scout
`geo_ref_bezirk` or `geo_ref_admin`. Search rows and Point features
are not outlines. A Berlin Bezirk alias (`11006006`, `11007007`, and
the same `11` + nnn + nnn pattern) is stored as official `1100000N`.
A hit with no catalog polygon is rejected. Bounds or a point are not
turned into a rectangle. One hit per geo key. The same display name
may appear twice only when `parentLabel` differs.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-text substring of the place name and parent municipality.
Does not match catalog keys. PLZ hits require `q` to be only digits.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Field that `q` is matched against. Ignored when `q` is absent.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Substring matched against the address and the label.

parameters.name: geoKey
parameters.description: Exact geo_key or catalog id. Reloads a stored place; not free-text.

200.description: Matching hits, at most 50, ordered by label.

get.description:
Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection as `application/json`.
Layer rows stay in schema `app` (`map_layers`, `map_features`) until
feature documents have coordinates. Seeded layer ids in local dev:
`demo-gemeinden`, `demo-plz`, `demo-grid100`.
`demo-gemeinden` has no features.
`demo-plz` and `demo-grid100` stay synthetic points.
Coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326), longitude then latitude.

200.description: Layer contents. An existing layer with no features returns an empty `features` array.

get.summary: Structured analysis input for the signed-in user
get.description:
Builds the Musteranalyse input from the user's saved target region,
store addresses, and monthly revenue (at most 36 months per store).
A revenue change counts only between two successive calendar months
that both have a non-null amount. `404` when no target region is
saved. `400` when no store has two adjacent months with revenue.

200.description: Input that a run would snapshot.

400.description: Region exists, but monthly revenue is not sufficient.

example.message: Die Monatsumsätze reichen für eine Musteranalyse nicht aus. Mindestens eine Filiale braucht zwei aufeinanderfolgende Monate mit gesetztem Umsatz.

404.description: This user has not saved a target region.

example.message: Keine Zielregion gespeichert. Bitte zuerst eine Zielregion anlegen.

post.summary: Snapshot input, search Brain, and persist a pattern
post.description:
Same preconditions as `GET /analysis/input`. On success the run is
stored for this user and includes the Brain facts used (region filter,
plus store postal codes) and the derived pattern. The pattern is the
input a later Top-3 step can read. This operation does not recommend
addresses.

400.description: Monthly revenue is not sufficient for a pattern.

404.description: This user has not saved a target region.

get.summary: Read one analysis run of the signed-in user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Run id as a decimal string.

200.description: The run, including input, Brain facts, and pattern.

404.description: No run with this id for the token's user.

get.summary: Latest persisted pattern for the signed-in user
get.description:
Without `geoKey`, returns the pattern from the newest completed run
(`input.region` is the Stand-line place). With `geoKey`, returns the
newest completed run whose snapshot includes that catalog key
(`input.region.geoKey` or any `input.regions[].geoKey`), after the
same Berlin Bezirk alias rewrite as add/remove on `/target-region`.
`yearlySeries` is then limited to that Zielregion. Criteria and
summary stay as stored. `404` when this user has no matching run —
never another region's pattern. This endpoint does not start a run.

200.description: Pattern for the latest matching completed run.

404.description:
No completed analysis run for this user, or `geoKey` did not
match any of this user's completed snapshots.

value.message: Es liegt noch kein Muster vor. Bitte zuerst eine Analyse starten.
Für diese Zielregion liegt noch kein Analyselauf vor.

post.description:
Reads a completed Musteranalyse for this user (the newest run, or
`runId` when set) and rebuilds pattern criteria from the
Bestandstandort surroundings (Ortsteil/PLZ near each store plus
three-year Gemeinde-/Kreis series). It then lists only the
**finest** Teilflächen inside the Zielregion (never the region
itself), evaluating small → large:

- Adresse (`kind=address`) from `geo.geo_ref_address` when rows
  exist for the Zielregion (Berlin, Hamburg, NRW). Empty or
  missing table is skipped; addresses are never invented.
- 100-m Raster (`grid100` / `breitband_gitter`)
- LOR Planungsraum 2021 (`lor:plr:*` / `geo.geo_ref_lor`) and
  Köln-Quartier (`koeln:sq:*`, `kind=quartier`). Finer than Ortsteil.
  2006 LOR (`lor:{RAUMID}`) is a separate series, used only when
  no PLR exists, never concatenated with 2021.
- Ortsteil / Stadtteil (`geo.geo_ref_ortsteil`; Hamburg also
  `hamburg_stadtteil:{id}` yearly series)
- PLZ5 (`geo.geo_ref_plz`)
- Stadtbezirk / Bezirk (`geo.geo_ref_bezirk`; München
  `muenchen_indikatorenatlas` on `bezirk:{id}`)
- Gemeinde (`geo.geo_ref_admin`) when no finer child exists

Parent→child membership prefers `geo.geo_ref_zielregion_teil`
(`within` / `partial`). Geometry fallback uses
`app.target_regions.geometry` and `geom_4326` / `geom_display`
on admin rows (`geom` is EPSG:3035, not WGS84).

A parent/ancestor is omitted when a finer child matches.
`items[].kind` is the Ebene. Criteria available only on a coarser
admin level have `criteriaEvidence[].scope: inherited` and do not
differentiate sibling Teilflächen. `scope: local` is native to
that hit.

Ranking uses the three-year trend where a **local** series exists
at the hit's own Ebene (`hamburg_stadtteil_regionalstatistik` on
Ortsteil, `muenchen_indikatorenatlas` on Stadtbezirk,
`berlin_lor_ewr_bevoelkerung` on LOR PLR, Köln/Leipzig/Düsseldorf/
Essen/Frankfurt kleinräumige themes, plus `unfallatlas_gebiet`
on Ortsteil/Bezirk/PLZ). Snapshot values are labeled `stichtag`.
Missing cells are `absent` (`liegt nicht vor`), never `0`.
Kleinräumige yearlySeries rows may have a null embedding.

An empty `items` array is success only when no sub-area exists
inside the region (`reason` explains that). `404` when this user
has no completed pattern, or when `runId` is not one of their runs.

Each item's `rationale` is German and grounded in
`criteriaEvidence`. `source` is `llm` when that text came from the
local model, otherwise `heuristic`.

201.description: Persisted recommendation set for this user.

pattern.summary: Unfälle fallen in der Filialumgebung im Dreijahresverlauf.

items.title: Schwabing-West
items.rationale: Die Teilfläche Schwabing-West (ortsteil:osm:5712247) im Vergleich zum Filialmuster. Quelle: Heuristik, ohne Sprachmodell.

404.description: No completed analysis pattern for this user, or the run id is not theirs.

value.message: Es liegt noch kein Muster vor. Bitte zuerst eine Analyse starten.

unknownRun.summary: runId is missing for this user

get.summary: Latest recommendation set for the signed-in user
get.description:
Returns the newest set stored by `POST /recommendations` for the token
user. `404` when this user has not computed recommendations yet.

404.description: This user has no stored recommendations.

example.message: Es liegen noch keine Empfehlungen vor. Bitte zuerst Empfehlungen berechnen.

post.summary: Compare Brain topics for two addresses
post.description:
Street and city are labels only. The lookup key is the five-digit
postal code. Two streets in the same PLZ return the same numbers.

A side is `resolved` only when that PLZ maps to exactly one
municipality and exactly one district in Brain `geo.geo_ref_plz` /
`geo.geo_ref_admin`. Otherwise `resolution` is `unknown`, places are
null, and `topics` is empty. `land` may be null when no Land row
exists. Place names are never invented.

Each resolved side returns the fixed topic lists at Gemeinde, Kreis,
and Land. `status: present` includes `value` as the stored Brain row.
`status: absent` omits `value`. Missing rows are never replaced with
0, null, or `{}`. Pendler, PKS, and Unfallatlas stay separate by
level. Arbeitsmarkt is Kreis only.

`shared` lists topics that are present on both sides at the same id
and level. The handler reads local Brain Postgres only.

200.description: Both sides, plus topics present on both.

StoreId.name: id
StoreId.description: Store id as a decimal string.

TargetRegionGeoKey.name: geoKey
TargetRegionGeoKey.description:
Catalog place id stored on the list item (`geoKey`). Same value
`GET /search` returns. A Berlin Bezirk alias is matched as the
official AGS.

AnalysisPatternGeoKey.name: geoKey
AnalysisPatternGeoKey.description:
Catalog place id (`TargetRegion.geoKey` / `GET /search`). When set,
the newest completed run whose snapshot includes this place is
returned. A Berlin Bezirk alias is matched as the official AGS.
Omit for the newest completed run of this user.

id.description: User id as a decimal string.

Grain.description: Spatial grain of a hit. Matches the Datenbasis grain list used by this slice.

CatalogLevel.description:
Machine token the web client maps to the badge. Never a German label.
`plz`, `bezirk`, `stadtbezirk`, `stadtteil`, `ortsteil` are Brain
`geo` sub-areas. `gemeinde` is a municipality (grain `ags`). Never
`gemeinde` for a sub-area.

geoKey.description:
Spatial key from the feature view or the geo catalog (AGS, PLZ,
Stadtteil/Ortsteil id). Null when unknown. This is the place id
`POST /target-region` and `DELETE /target-region/{geoKey}` use.
It is not itself a polygon. Brain `geo` holds PLZ, Bezirk,
Stadtteil, and Ortsteil outlines. A Berlin Bezirk alias is stored
as `1100000N`. Free-text `q` does not match this key.

parentLabel.description:
Display name of the parent Gemeinde, not a second label for the
area itself and not a German badge. Distinguishes same-named
sub-areas. Null when unknown or the hit is the municipality.

geoAgs.description:
Parent municipality AGS from the table column `geo_ags`.
Null when the table has no value.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude. Omitted or null when the hit is not geocoded.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude. Omitted or null when the hit is not geocoded.

Geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry. This slice seeds Point and Polygon.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates. Position order is longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326).

properties.description: Includes label, grain, and stub: true for seeded demo features.

FeatureCollection.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection. `name` and `description` are foreign members
carried for this API (RFC 7946 allows them).

LonLatBounds.description:
Axis-aligned WGS84 extent for map fitBounds. `west` and `east` are
longitudes, `south` and `north` are latitudes. Clients union this box
with store pin coordinates.

RegionGeometry.description:
GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon for the target-region overlay
(semi-transparent fill and outline). Position order is longitude,
latitude (EPSG:4326). Rings are closed. This slice uses the same
synthetic stubs as `/layers/{id}` when the client does not send one.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates for the declared type.

TargetRegion.description:
One saved place in the user's target-region list. Display fields
match a search hit: `label`, `level`, `parentLabel`. `geoKey` names
the place for add and remove.

grain.description: Same values as Grain. Null when the region is a free-text label.

geoKey.description:
Stored catalog key. A Berlin Bezirk alias sent on add is returned
as the official AGS `1100000N`. Clients use this to remove the
item. It is not a display field.

level.description:
Same tokens as `SearchHit.level`. `plz`; `bezirk` only for Berlin
`11000001`–`11000012`; `stadtbezirk` for every other Bezirk;
`stadtteil` or `ortsteil` from the catalog kind; `gemeinde` for
a municipality (grain `ags`). Never `gemeinde` for a sub-area.

parentLabel.description:
Parent municipality name, same as `SearchHit.parentLabel`. Not a
second name for the area. Null when unknown or the item is the
municipality.

ags.description:
Stored official AGS. Add rewrites `11006006` to `11000006` and
`11007007` to `11000007`.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude of a representative point. Null when unknown.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude of a representative point. Null when unknown.

bounds.description:
Extent of `geometry` for map fitBounds. Null on `GET` only when a
previously stored region still has no outline and the catalog has
no point. A successful add always returns bounds.

geometry.description:
Overlay polygon. Null on `GET` only when a previously stored
region still has no outline and the catalog has none. A successful
add always returns a Polygon or MultiPolygon.

items.description: Saved places, newest add first. Empty when none are stored.

geoKey.description:
Place id. A Berlin Bezirk alias `11` + nnn + nnn is stored as the
official AGS `1100000N` (an `ags:` prefix is kept).

ags.description:
Official AGS. Berlin Bezirk aliases such as `11006006` and
`11007007` are stored as `11000006` and `11000007`.

bounds.description:
Optional extent. Ignored. Bounds on a successful add are derived
from the stored polygon. Bounds without a polygon do not become
a rectangle. A successful add always returns non-null `bounds`.

geometry.description:
Optional GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (EPSG:4326). When set, it
is the overlay and replaces any catalog outline. A place id from
`GET /search` is not an outline. A successful add never persists
null geometry. If this is omitted and the catalog has no polygon,
the add is `400`.

id.description: Store id as a decimal string.

lon.description:
WGS84 longitude for the map pin. Resolved, when a write omits both
coordinates, from Data-Scout `geo_ref_address`, then `geo_ref_plz`,
then the PLZ stub in `app.search_places` or `app.map_features`.

lat.description:
WGS84 latitude for the map pin. Resolved, when a write omits both
coordinates, from Data-Scout `geo_ref_address`, then `geo_ref_plz`,
then the PLZ stub in `app.search_places` or `app.map_features`.

lon.description:
WGS84 longitude. Omit together with `lat` to resolve
`geo_ref_address`, then `geo_ref_plz`, then the PLZ stub.

lat.description:
WGS84 latitude. Omit together with `lon` to resolve
`geo_ref_address`, then `geo_ref_plz`, then the PLZ stub.

revenueEur.description: EUR. Null means the month was marked missing.

AnalysisInput.description:
Snapshot of customer inputs used for Musteranalyse. `regions` is the
saved target-region list (the set for the location search). `region`
is the newest item and stays for older snapshots that only stored one
place. `stores[].points` holds up to 36 months. `changes` links only
successive calendar months that both have a revenue.

regions.description:
Full target-region list at snapshot time, newest first. Location
search uses this set. Omitted on runs created before the list.

changeEur.description: toRevenueEur minus fromRevenueEur, rounded to cents.

RevenueDirection.description: Sign of the summed month-to-month revenue changes. Flat means the sum is zero.

CriterionDirection.description:
Direction of one Brain criterion. `unknown` means the facts do not
show a change over time (a Stichtag, or the series is absent).

CriterionKind.description:
`trend` is a multi-year / multi-period series. `stichtag` is a single
snapshot and must not be treated as month-to-month direction.

AreaKind.description:
Ebene of a Teilfläche inside the Zielregion. Never the region itself.
Only the finest matching Ebene is returned (Adresse → Raster →
LOR Planungsraum / Köln-Quartier → Ortsteil → PLZ5 → Bezirk →
Gemeinde). `address` is skipped when `geo.geo_ref_address` is empty
or unavailable. `lor` is Berlin LOR Planungsraum (`lor:plr:*`
preferred; 2006 `lor:{RAUMID}` is separate). `quartier` is Köln
`koeln:sq:*`.

EvidenceKind.description:
How this criterion was observed on the Teilfläche. `absent` means
the value liegt nicht vor (never invented as 0).

EvidenceScope.description:
`local` — the value is native to this Teilfläche's Ebene.
`inherited` — the value comes from a coarser parent (Gemeinde,
Kreis, …) and is the same for sibling hits; it does not
differentiate them.

id.description: Run id as a decimal string.

AnalysisBrain.description:
Facts retrieved for this run. `vector` means cosine similarity over
Brain embeddings, filtered to the target region and store postal
codes. `sql` means the same filters without a vector (embeddings
unset, unreachable, or not usable). This is not a raw Brain dump.

factCount.description: Number of facts included on this run.

excerpt.description: Short prose from the feature document, or the title when no prose is stored.

distance.description: Cosine distance when mode is vector. Null for the SQL filter.

matchedBy.description:
`region` matches the target region ags, plz, or geoKey.
`store` matches a store postal code.
`label` is the text fallback when the region has no geo key.

value.description:
Display value for this signal. Count-like metrics (dwellings,
population, age-band and other person counts, SGB2 BG/PERS, …)
are whole numbers. Rates, shares, and percentages stay fractional.

SeriesLevel.description:
Geographic level of a yearlySeries row. `sourceLevel` is the stored
Brain row. `requestedLevel` is the Zielregion or Teilfläche.
Grain `ags5` and a 5-digit AGS (Köln `05315`) are `kreis`, never
`gemeinde`. `grid100` and `address` are Stage-1 hit Ebenen.
`lor` is Berlin LOR Planungsraum (`lor:plr:*` preferred over 2006
`lor:{RAUMID}`). `quartier` is Köln `koeln:sq:*`. Both sit finer
than Ortsteil. Gemeinde or Kreis numbers are never labeled as
Stadtteil, Ortsteil, PLZ, or Stadtbezirk.

SeriesCoverage.description:
How many stored Brain periods exist in the three-year window.
`none` — every period liegt nicht vor.
`single` — exactly one present point; do not draw a trend line.
`multi` — two or more present points (a change can be shown).

SeriesPointStatus.description:
`absent` means the period liegt nicht vor. `value` is omitted.
Never 0, null, or {} as a stand-in. A real stored 0 is `present`.
Placeholder zeros (KBA Elektro counts of 0 while `pkw_elektro_anteil`
is positive) are `absent` without `value`.

period.description:
Calendar stamp. `YYYY` when granularity is year, `YYYY-MM` when
month. Theme suffixes on Brain `ref_period` (`2025-12|bka`) are
stripped. A quarter such as `2026-Q1` is the year `2026`, not a
fabricated month.

value.description:
Stored Brain cell for this period. Omitted when absent.
Not a geo identifier (`ba_schluessel`, `geo_ags`, `geo_ags5`,
`geo_key`, `source_theme`). Count-like metrics (dwellings,
population, age-band and other person counts, SGB2 BG, PERS,
ELB, NEF, RLB) are whole numbers. Rates, shares, and percentages
stay fractional.

normalizedValue.description:
Raw `value` divided by the area Bezugsgröße (`per_1000_inhabitants`
is per 1.000 inhabitants). Omitted when the Bezugsgröße for that
Fläche and year liegt nicht vor. Never invented as `0`.
`baselineMethod: missing` always omits this field.

baselineMethod.description:
Method of the divisor actually used from `geo.area_baseline`.
Omitted on older stored sets and on feature-derived fallback.

SeriesBaseline.description:
Bezugsgröße used to baseline a dataset on its own Fläche.
`per_1000_inhabitants` — je 1.000 Einwohner.
`per_km2` — je km² (Einwohner stock, or when area is the baseline).
`per_household` — je Haushalt.
Missing divisor → `normalizedValue` omitted, status `absent`.

BaselineMethod.description:
Method of the Bezugsgröße from Brain `geo.area_baseline`.
Einwohner: `official` | `estimate_lor_sum` | `estimate_address` |
`missing` (never a silent NULL). Fläche: `geom` | `official` |
`fixed_grid`. `missing` means `normalizedValue` is absent; never
divide by 1.

YearlySeries.description:
One topic on one Zielregion over the last three UTC calendar years
(`year`) or the last 36 UTC months (`month`). When the newest Brain
year is older than `asOf` but still within two years, the year
window ends on that Brain year so a series such as Wanderungen
through 2024 stays `multi`. `coverage` tells the client whether a
trend exists. `sourceLevel` / `sourceGeoKey` are the Brain row, not
the picker grain. Unfallatlas Gebiet may be Ortsteil, Bezirk, or
PLZ when that key exists; Gemeinde/Kreis/Land AGS series stay on
grain `ags` / `ags5` / `other` and are labeled as such. An Ortsteil
or Stadtteil picker still produces this array: missing local rows
fall back to Gemeinde / Kreis / Land. Grain `ags5` / a 5-digit AGS
is requested as `kreis`. Missing cells are `absent` without `value`.
Store revenue is not included.

metricId.description:
Address-pair topic id (`bevoelkerung`, `pendler`, …) or a Brain
series theme id (`destatis_wohnungen`, `kba_elektro_pkw`,
`hamburg_stadtteil_regionalstatistik`,
`muenchen_indikatorenatlas`, `berlin_lor_ewr_bevoelkerung`,
`koeln_statistischer_datenkatalog`, `leipzig_lis_ortsteil`,
`duesseldorf_bevoelkerung_stadtteile`,
`essen_bevoelkerung_stadtteile`,
`frankfurt_demographie_stadtteile`, …).
Not store revenue. Kleinräumige themes score at the hit's own
Ebene (Adresse, Raster, LOR/Quartier, Ortsteil, Stadtbezirk)
and do not require an embedding. Berlin LOR 2021 PLR and 2006
are separate series.

sourceGeoKey.description: Geo key of the Brain row, or the Gemeinde/Kreis/Land key that was looked up.

valueKey.description: Metadata field the `value` numbers were taken from, when the row is an object.

points.description:
Every expected period in the window. Missing Brain rows are
`absent` without `value`. Present points are stored cells only.

AnalysisPattern.description:
Persisted pattern for recommendations. `source` is `llm` when the
criteria were taken from the language model and checked against the
store-surrounding facts, otherwise `heuristic`. `yearlySeries` is the
three-year small-area Brain history for the user's Zielregionen
(Verlauf). Pattern `criteria` come from Bestandstandort surroundings.
A `coverage` of `single` is a Stichtag, not a trend.

criteria.description:
At most five grounded criteria. Heuristic values come from
Bestandstandort surroundings (Adresse → Raster → LOR/Quartier →
Ortsteil → PLZ5 → Bezirk → Gemeinde; Kreis is Rahmen only, e.g.
Köln ags5 `05315`), never from clipping Brain facts to the
Zielregion. Destatis `bev_insgesamt` at ags5 is preferred for
Einwohner over Zensus `ewz`. A Kreis or Land fallback is labeled
as such. Missing values are absent (liegt nicht vor), never
invented.

evidence.description:
Grounded in store-surrounding Brain series or the stored revenue
series. Nested metric keys use the leaf in heuristic period stamps
(`wohnungen.raeume` → `2020|Räume` / `raeume`), not the parent
Brain `ref_period` suffix (`2020|wohnungen`). Heuristic numbers
use only the Filialumgebung keys, never a mean across foreign
places. Stichtag snapshots say so; missing cells are
`liegt nicht vor`, never `0`.

sourceLevel.description: Flächenebene on which this dataset is present.

scope.description:
Present on `patternByLevel` / `patternByDataset` criteria.
`local` is native to that Fläche. `inherited` was taken from a
coarser parent and does not differentiate siblings. Omitted on
older `pattern.criteria`.

metricId.description:
Dataset / Brain theme id this criterion compares (`kba_elektro_pkw`,
`unfallatlas`, …). Same as `key` on new sets. Additive.

baseline.description: Bezugsgröße for the relative match. Omitted on older stored sets.

rawValue.description: Latest present raw Brain cell. Omitted when every period is absent.

normalizedValue.description:
Latest present `rawValue` after baselining. Omitted when the
Bezugsgröße liegt nicht vor. Never `0` as a stand-in.

baselineMethod.description:
Method of the latest present Bezugsgröße. `missing` when the
catalog theme has no usable divisor for that year.

PatternLevel.description:
Canonical Ebene of a store-surroundings Musterprofil.
`stadtteil` folds into `ortsteil`; `stadtbezirk` into `bezirk`.
`kreis` is Rahmen only (`role: frame`).

PatternLevelRole.description:
Geography inventory on `patternByLevel`. `frame` (Kreis) is context
only. Compare/score uses `patternByDataset`, not same-Ebene matching.

PatternLevelProfile.description:
Store-surroundings pattern at one Ebene. `yearlySeries` are the
last three available years for that Ebene. Missing years are
`absent` (liegt nicht vor), never `0`. `criteria` are derived
from those series (max 5) with `scope` `local` or `inherited`.

geoKeys.description: Bestandstandort geo keys aggregated at this Ebene.

PatternDatasetProfile.description:
Store-surroundings Musterprofil for one dataset. `yearlySeries` is
the finest Bestandstandort Fläche where that metric exists.
`normalizedValue` on points and on `criterion` is the relative
match (je 1.000 Einwohner, je km², or je Haushalt). Missing
Bezugsgröße omits `normalizedValue`. Additive; older stored sets
may omit `patternByDataset`.

sourceLevel.description: Flächenebene on which this dataset is present.

baselineMethod.description: Method of the Bezugsgröße on this dataset profile. Additive.

AnalysisPatternRegion.description:
Snapshot place this pattern belongs to, for the Stand line
(`Stand: Lauf vom … für [label]`). Unfiltered GET uses `input.region`.
With `geoKey`, the matching list item. `parentLabel` is optional.

geoKey.description: Stored catalog key of the snapshot place. Null when unknown.

parentLabel.description: Parent municipality name. Null when unknown or the place is the municipality.

RecommendationCreate.description:
Optional body for `POST /recommendations`. Omit `runId` to use the
newest completed analysis run of the token user.

runId.description: Analysis run id as a decimal string. Must belong to the token user.

RecommendationSet.description:
Ranked Teilflächen the web client binds to. `count` is
`items.length`. `reason` is null when at least one sub-area
exists and the catalog read was not truncated. `pattern` is the
flattened store-surroundings snapshot (older clients).
`patternByLevel` is the geography inventory je Ebene.
`patternByDataset` is the Musterprofil used for dataset compare
(normalized trend per metricId). Empty `items` only when no
sub-area exists inside the Zielregion. Hit size is the Fläche
where the dataset lives, not the smallest admin Ebene at all
costs; several datasets yield their intersection.

id.description: Recommendation set id as a decimal string.

runId.description: Analysis run this set was ranked from.

reason.description:
German explanation when no finer Teilfläche exists inside the
region, or when the catalog read hit its row limit. Null when
finest sub-areas were ranked without truncation.

patternByLevel.description:
Store-surroundings Musterprofil je Ebene, finest → coarse.
New `POST /recommendations` includes the Ebenen resolved for
the Bestandstandorte. Older stored sets may omit this field.
Geography inventory only; compare/score uses `patternByDataset`.
Kreis is `role: frame` and does not differentiate siblings.

patternByDataset.description:
Store-surroundings Musterprofil je Datensatz (normalized
value + three-year trend at the finest Fläche where that
metric exists). New `POST /recommendations` always includes
it. Older stored sets may omit the field. Web uses this to
show the relative dataset match, not only Muster je Ebene.

RecommendationWindow.description:
Three calendar years used for trend ranking (`YYYY`), inclusive.
Older stored sets may still use `YYYY-MM` (six-month window).

from.description: Oldest year (or month) in the window.

to.description: Newest year (or month) in the window.

id.description: Stable area id `{grain}:{geoKey}` inside this set.

title.description: Card title. Place name or geo key from geo_ref.

kind.description:
Ebene of this hit (Adresse, 100-m-Raster, Ortsteil, LOR, PLZ,
Bezirk, Gemeinde). Required on new sets.

score.description:
Share of **local** three-year trend criteria whose **normalized**
direction matches the store-surroundings pattern of the **same
dataset** (`metricId`). Different Ebenen may still match when
both are baselined (Berlin Bezirk vs Köln PLZ). Inherited
parent-level trends and Kreis-frame series do not change this
score. Stichtag criteria are labeled and do not drive this
score. Missing Bezugsgröße is absent and does not match. 1 is
a full local trend fit.

rationale.description:
German Begründung. Names only criteria and figures present in
`criteriaEvidence`.

source.description:
`llm` when `rationale` was taken from the local model and checked
against `criteriaEvidence`. `heuristic` when the model was unset,
failed, or its text was discarded.

name.description: Brain place name when the row has one.

RecommendationEvidence.description:
One pattern criterion observed on this Teilfläche.
`kind` is `trend`, `stichtag`, or `absent`. `status` is `present`
or `absent`. Missing values omit `value` / `normalizedValue` and
are never `0`. `patternDirection` is the stored Musteranalyse
direction. `scope` is `local` when the series is native to this
Fläche, or `inherited` when it was taken from a coarser parent.
`metricId`, `baseline`, `rawValue`, `normalizedValue`, and
`sourceLevel` (Flächenebene) describe the dataset compare.

evidence.description:
German sentence with the years/Stichtag and figures used for the
score, or `liegt nicht vor`. Nested metric keys use the leaf
label (`Räume` / `raeume` for `wohnungen.raeume`), not the parent key.

match.description: True when a trend criterion moved in the pattern direction.

sourceLevel.description: Flächenebene on which this dataset is present.

metricId.description: Dataset / Brain theme id compared on this Fläche.

rawValue.description: Latest present raw Brain cell. Omitted when absent.

normalizedValue.description:
Latest present baselined value. Omitted when the Bezugsgröße
liegt nicht vor. Never invented as `0`.

baselineMethod.description: Method of the divisor used on this Teilfläche. Additive.

value.description:
Stored Brain row. Present only when `status` is `present`.
Omitted entirely when `status` is `absent`.
